The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
List<Stage> stages = db.getFirstStageInProgressPerRequest();
HashSet<String> hostsWithTasks = getListOfHostsWithPendingTask(stages);
```
Reason:
The system was retrieving the first stage in progress for each request without properly filtering for intersecting hosts. This led to commands being queued incorrectly, as stages from different requests could be executed in parallel even when they shared hosts, causing blocking behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
List<Stage> firstStageInProgressPerRequest = db.getFirstStageInProgressPerRequest();
List<String> hostsWithPendingTasks = hostRoleCommandDAO.getHostsWithPendingTasks(iLowestRequestIdInProgress, iHighestRequestIdInProgress);
```
Reason:
The fix involves retrieving the first stage in progress per request and then checking for hosts with pending tasks across the range of requests in progress. This ensures that stages are only executed in parallel if their hosts do not intersect, thus preventing the blocking behavior that was previously occurring.
